title: Higher Education Legislation Amendment (Voluntary Student Services and Amenities Fee) Bill 2019
short_title: Higher Education Legislation Amendment (Voluntary Student Services and Amenities Fee) Bill 2019

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would stop higher education providers imposing compulsory student services and amenities fees, while allowing them to request voluntary contributions for those services.
It would repeal the government loan assistance used to finance those fees and remove related provisions governing fee amounts, indexation, spending and administrative requirements.
The substantive amendments would commence on 31 May 2019, with the Minister able to make transitional rules addressing matters including debts incurred under the repealed scheme.
changes: Statutory guidelines controlling how providers spend services and amenities fees would be removed.
Commonwealth-funded providers would lose the requirement to comply with services, amenities, representation and advocacy guidelines.
Tax file number requirements specific to the repealed fee-loan assistance would be removed.
The Minister's authority to make the associated student services and advocacy guidelines would be repealed.
summary.affected: Higher education students, people seeking enrolment, higher education providers and borrowers under the services and amenities loan scheme are affected.
